name: reasoning-details-replay-number-forms
note: Upstream 4ca636c5e+b7bb00b93. pi does not replay the provider's BYTES: it replays the object JSON.parse produced, re-serialized by the SDK, so a redundant number form is renormalized on the wire (1.0 -> 1, 1e2 -> 100, -0 -> 0) and a magnitude float64 cannot hold survives validation as Infinity and is written as null. Python-stack providers reached through OpenRouter emit 1.0-style float literals routinely, so this is the reachable half. Post-0.84.2 surface, so backend is src: REQUIRES PI_UPSTREAM_SHA >= b7bb00b93. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.3 (release 4e58f324f); flipped to backend:"dist" — the published build is the stronger ground truth (README rule).
